artifacts_team_scope.name: artifacts_team_scope
artifacts_team_scope.value: scope not in ('project', 'team') or team_id is not null

artifacts_team_only_scoped.name: artifacts_team_only_scoped
artifacts_team_only_scoped.value: scope in ('project', 'team') or team_id is null

doc_assets_blob.name: doc_assets_blob
doc_assets_blob.value: state not in ('available', 'pending_push') or blob_id is not null

doc_conflicts_resolution.name: doc_conflicts_resolution
doc_conflicts_resolution.value: resolution is null or resolution in ('hub', 'repo', 'manual')

doc_homes_scope.name: doc_homes_scope
doc_homes_scope.value: (scope = 'project' and project_id is not null) or (scope = 'org' and project_id is null)

doc_drafts_scope.name: doc_drafts_scope
doc_drafts_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

doc_snapshots_scope.name: doc_snapshots_scope
doc_snapshots_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

doc_suggestions_scope.name: doc_suggestions_scope
doc_suggestions_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

doc_threads_scope.name: doc_threads_scope
doc_threads_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

docs_scope.name: docs_scope
docs_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

memories_scope.name: memories_scope
memories_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

proposals_scope.name: proposals_scope
proposals_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

review_instances_scope.name: review_instances_scope
review_instances_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

skills_scope.name: skills_scope
skills_scope.value: project_id is null or team_id is not null

mcp_server_rules_launch.name: mcp_server_rules_launch
mcp_server_rules_launch.value:
("hive"."mcp_server_rules"."transport" is null and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."command" is null and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."url" is null)
          or ("hive"."mcp_server_rules"."transport" = 'stdio' and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."command" is not null and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."url" is null)
          or ("hive"."mcp_server_rules"."transport" = 'http' and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."url" is not null and "hive"."mcp_server_rules"."command" is null)

runs_leader_thread_active.name: runs_leader_thread_active
runs_leader_thread_active.where: leader_thread_id is not null and state not in ('succeeded', 'no_changes', 'needs_review', 'failed', 'cancelled')

runs_brief_active.name: runs_brief_active
runs_brief_active.where: branch like 'brief/%' and state not in ('succeeded', 'no_changes', 'needs_review', 'failed', 'cancelled')

learned_skill_proposals_delivery.name: learned_skill_proposals_delivery
learned_skill_proposals_delivery.value: delivery_mode is null or delivery_mode in ('pr', 'saved')

learned_skill_proposals_scope.name: learned_skill_proposals_scope
learned_skill_proposals_scope.value: scope_project_id is null or scope_team_id is not null

orgs_select.name: orgs_select
orgs_select.using: id = hive.ctx_org() or exists (select 1 from hive.org_members m where m.org_id = orgs.id and m.user_id = hive.ctx_user() and m.status = 'active')

terminal_sessions_hub_fields.name: terminal_sessions_hub_fields
terminal_sessions_hub_fields.value: "hive"."terminal_sessions"."origin" <> 'hub' or ("hive"."terminal_sessions"."project_id" is not null and "hive"."terminal_sessions"."mode" is not null and "hive"."terminal_sessions"."model" is not null)
